blocks.name: LoginForm
blocks.description: Sign-in card with environment picker, username/password and an optional MFA one-time-code variant. Presentation-only; emits values via onSubmit.

blocks.name: DocumentFieldsForm
blocks.description: Editable grid of OCR-extracted document fields. Fields below a confidence threshold are flagged for operator review; confirm emits corrected values.

blocks.name: SearchFilterBar
blocks.description: Search box plus configurable filters (select/text/date) with Apply and Clear actions for queue lookups.

blocks.name: ApplicationsTable
blocks.description: Inbox queue table: applicant, document type, status badge, pool, locked-by and received date. Single click selects, double click opens.

blocks.name: StatusBadge
blocks.description: Coloured badge for the application lifecycle: pending, in-review, verified, rejected, referred, on-hold, completed, failed.

blocks.name: FieldFeedback
blocks.description: Expandable list of field-level check results (pass/info/warning/fail) with summary message and optional detail text.

blocks.name: WizardStepper
blocks.description: Horizontal steps bar with back/next controls, optional-step hints and click-to-revisit completed steps.

blocks.name: ImageViewer
blocks.description: Document image viewer with colour/IR/UV channel switching, zoom, rotate and optional side-by-side reference comparison.

blocks.name: AppShell
blocks.description: Application frame: role-filtered drawer sidebar, top bar with org badge and user account menu. Wraps page content.
